**Build it yourself.** [Read the tutorial](../read/step-00.qmd) is the other way to read this part.

This walk goes through [rahuldave/cheesecracker](https://github.com/rahuldave/cheesecracker) on GitHub. This part is where the project starts, at `step-00`. [The code of this part](https://github.com/rahuldave/cheesecracker/tree/step-00){.btn .btn-sm .btn-primary}

The first recipe, `setup`, makes the environment of the project.

```bash
just setup
```

The project is empty. It has a `pyproject.toml` with no dependencies, an empty `uv.lock`, a `README.md`, a
`.gitignore`, and a `justfile` with one recipe, `setup`. `just setup` runs `uv sync --locked`. uv is the tool that installs Python and
packages. The command makes the folder `.venv`, with Python 3.12 and every package of `uv.lock` in it. Run it again.

```bash
just setup
```

uv prints `Resolved 1 package` and `Checked`, and no line `Creating virtual environment`. A second run changes
nothing.

Two settings of `pyproject.toml`, in the table `[tool.uv]`, matter for the whole project. `package = false` says that
cheesecracker is an application. uv installs its dependencies, and does not install the project as a package.
`default-groups = "all"` makes `uv sync` and `uv run` install every group of dependencies, such as the tools of the
tests.

```bash
just --list
```

`just --list` prints the one recipe, `setup`, with its comment.

Check your files against this part. The command prints nothing when they match, and otherwise shows what differs:

```bash
git check cf50a6ef5045
```

If you are stuck, this command puts the files of this part in place of yours. A file that you made yourself stays:

```bash
git fetch --quiet --tags --force origin; git rm -rq --cached --ignore-unmatch -- :/ && git restore --source step-00 --staged --worktree -- :/
```

## What changed {#step-00-what-changed-182c57}

- <a id="step-00-.gitignore-a5cc29"></a>`.gitignore`: the environment, the caches of the tools, and the secrets, which git never takes. New, 21 lines. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/cheesecracker/blob/cf50a6ef5045e08ca727aeaffdb710fad2cae096/.gitignore){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}
- <a id="step-00-.python-version-7696e9"></a>`.python-version`: the version of Python that uv installs, 3.12. New, 1 line. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/cheesecracker/blob/cf50a6ef5045e08ca727aeaffdb710fad2cae096/.python-version){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}
- <a id="step-00-README.md-8ec9a0"></a>`README.md`: what the project is, and how to set it up. New, 14 lines. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/cheesecracker/blob/cf50a6ef5045e08ca727aeaffdb710fad2cae096/README.md){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}
- <a id="step-00-justfile-424f0b"></a>`justfile`: the recipe `setup`, and `default`, which lists the recipes. New, 12 lines. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/cheesecracker/blob/cf50a6ef5045e08ca727aeaffdb710fad2cae096/justfile){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}
  - look at `uv sync --locked`
- <a id="step-00-pyproject.toml-5d07e7"></a>`pyproject.toml`: the name of the project, no dependencies yet, and the table `[tool.uv]`. New, 13 lines. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/cheesecracker/blob/cf50a6ef5045e08ca727aeaffdb710fad2cae096/pyproject.toml){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}
  - look at `default-groups = "all"`
- <a id="step-00-uv.lock-8356d8"></a>`uv.lock`: the lockfile, with the project and no packages yet. New, 8 lines. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/cheesecracker/blob/cf50a6ef5045e08ca727aeaffdb710fad2cae096/uv.lock){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}

@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+# cheesecracker
+
+cheesecracker is the API server of the Cheese App, a class project of AC215. The server answers a few HTTP
+requests. The project shows how to test a server, check its code, and run it in Docker.
+
+## Run it
+
+You need [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) and [just](https://just.systems/). Then run:
+
+```
+just setup
+```
+
+`just` lists every recipe of the project.
````

</details>

<details><summary>The diff of <code>justfile</code></summary>

```diff
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+# cheesecracker: every task is a recipe here. `just` lists them.
+
+# Each word after a recipe's name reaches its commands whole, as "$1", "$2" and so on; "$@" is all of them
+set positional-arguments
+
+[private]
+default:
+    @just --list --unsorted
+
+# Install Python and every dependency into .venv, exactly as the lockfile says
+setup:
+    uv sync --locked
```

</details>

<details><summary>The diff of <code>pyproject.toml</code></summary>

```diff
@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+[project]
+name = "cheesecracker"
+version = "0.1.0"
+description = "The Cheese App's API server, with its tests, its checks and its Docker images"
+readme = "README.md"
+requires-python = ">=3.12"
+dependencies = []
+
+[tool.uv]
+# The project is an application, not a library: uv installs its dependencies, and not the project itself
+package = false
+# uv sync and uv run install every dependency group, not only dev
+default-groups = "all"
```
